notes: Live UI/tactics follow-up. Boots moved to their own NUI line under armor. Buff hover names are wrapped into compact multiline tooltips and the buff strip uses a fresh window id. Actual XAI ammo scoring now reads target elemental vulnerability, immunity and resistance from equipped items and creature skin: strong vulnerabilities such as cold +100% heavily favor matching cold arrows/bolts whenever ranged combat is tactically appropriate; immunity/resistance penalize matching ammo. Panel reason prioritizes an exploited vulnerability. Existing DR display, safe boots auto-equip, weak-target ammo conservation, reader, targeting, dual-wield and PRC familiar FIX5 remain unchanged. Reader latency is also reworked: the first short phrase starts through edge-playback while the entire remaining book is synthesized in parallel to MP3; after the first phrase it switches to the prefetched MP3, removing the old network/TTS pause between every text block. STOP kills both playback and background prefetch.
